rv.q: It is a mesmeric performance which hits the notes but does so much more.
But, at the heart of this show is solid gold.
There is not a single dull moment or wasted word in this show.

cn.t: Critics praise this production for its heartfelt performances, particularly Kirsty Findlay's transformative turn as Carole King, capturing the iconic singer's voice with remarkable authenticity in a charming songbook journey.
